title: 上下文的语义线索
goal: 利用话题复现与句间逻辑确定空缺词义。

points.label: 利用话题与同义复现确定词义
利用句间逻辑筛选候选词

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 几个候选词语法上都成立时，比较它们与上下文的意思。依据常在空位的前一句或后一句。
话题词和同义表达提供内容线索；对比、因果与举例提供句间关系线索。

cards.title: 话题与同义复现
rows: The tanks hold rainwater. They ___ water for dry months.
The buses stop at each village. This ___ links residents to town.
The path is steep. Its sharp ___ makes cycling difficult.
The room is silent. This ___ helps readers concentrate.

cards.title: 对比、因果与举例
rows: The old route was long. However, the new one is ___.
The first sample was dry; the second, in contrast, was ___.
The path was icy. As a result, walking was ___.
The tank leaked, so the water level ___.
The garden attracted several ___. Bees and butterflies visited it.
The shop sells tools, such as hammers and ___.
saws 与 hammers 同属工具
cards.note: 线索确定词义的大致范围。选定后再核对词性和搭配。

items.stem: The shelves hold books for loan. The ___ is open on weekdays. Which word completes the second sentence?
items.why: books for loan 提示讨论借书场所，library 与话题对应。

items.stem: The instructions are clear and easy to follow. Their ___ helps new staff. Which word completes the second sentence?
items.why: clarity 与前句的 clear 对应。

items.stem: The first road is wide, but the second is ___. Which word completes the sentence?
items.why: but 表示对比；narrow 与 wide 相对。

items.stem: The full container was sealed, so its liquid could not ___ through the lid. Which word completes the sentence?
items.why: sealed 与 so 支持容器内的液体无法逸出，即 escape。

items.stem: The surface has many small holes. These ___ allow air to pass through. Which word completes the second sentence?
items.why: openings 与前句的 small holes 对应。

items.stem: The menu lists several grains, including rice and ___. Which word completes the sentence?
items.why: including 后是谷物的例子，wheat 与 rice 同属谷物。

groups.text: A town archive keeps old letters in protective folders. Each folder has a number, and a list records where it is stored. This ___ helps staff find a letter without searching every shelf.

items.why: 编号和记录存放位置共同组成 system，说明如何找到信件。

groups.text: The speaker used simple words and short sentences. This ___ made the explanation easier for the audience to follow.

items.why: simplicity 概括 simple words and short sentences。

groups.text: The garden has a fence to keep animals away from young plants. The ___ also has a gate through which gardeners can enter.

items.why: barrier 与前句的 fence 对应，后句继续说明围栏。

groups.text: One container lets light pass through, but the other blocks it. The second container is ___.

items.why: blocks light 表示不透光；opaque 与前面透光的容器形成对比。

groups.text: The road was closed after a bridge inspection. As a result, drivers had to take a longer ___.

items.why: 道路关闭导致司机绕行；longer route 表示更长的路线。

groups.text: The workshop uses several measuring instruments. For example, a ruler measures length and a scale measures ___.

items.why: scale 与 ruler 是测量工具的例子；scale 可测量 weight。
